map.铣削参数计算 使用指南: How to use the milling parameter calculator
map.：硬质合金铣刀 dia=20mm、z=4、vc=120m/min、fz=0.1m: : carbide cutter dia=20mm, z=4, vc=120 m/min, fz=0.1 mm: n = 1000x120/(pi x20) ≈ 1910 rpm, Vf = 1910x4x0.1 = 764 mm/min, f = 4x0.1 = 0.4 mm/r.
map.：若 vc 降至 80m/min、dia 不变：n = 1000×80÷(π×2: : if vc drops to 80 m/min with dia unchanged: n = 1000x80/(pi x20) ≈ 1273 rpm, and Vf drops by nearly 1/3 in proportion, which suits hard-to-machine materials such as stainless steel.
